Name: Sprite Accurate Ohodavi Portraits
Author: Miri0929
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]I've always disliked how the portraits are different from the sprites in Stardew Valley (both vanilla and mostly all other portrait mods). Mostly when it comes to colors. So I changed it myself!. I'm going to slowly add onto it with other characters. This was mostly for my own pleasure, but I decided why not share it with others?[/color]

[b]This is in no way meant to shame or criticize other portrait mods[/b], because [u]even the VANILLA portraits are colored differently[/u] than their sprites! And I suspect most ppl go off of the portraits for the colors of their own portraits, which is quite understandable! The color difference is a personal pet peeve of mine.

[b]Plans for the future:[/b]
-Penny (her hair is more ginger in her sprites)
-Haley (her normal outfit is mainly white instead of blue like in her sprites)
-Marnie (her hair color is more brown in her sprites)
-Demetrius (his skin color is darker in his sprites, though I already have him recolored from a different portrait.)

[b]Instructions:[/b]
Go into portraiture and just put the png's in your portraits folder!
